2608.07294.title: FUSE: Feature-Wise Unified Specialization with Cross-Column Exchange for Mixed-Type Tabular Flow Matching
2608.07294.paper_summary: Generating mixed-type tabular data requires jointly modeling diverse feature distributions and their complex cross-column dependencies. Variational flow matching handles distinct endpoints via factorized distributions, yet leaves feature-specific processing and cross-column interactions implicit within a shared backbone. We introduce Feature-wise Unified Specialization with cross-column Exchange (FUSE) to explicitly separate these roles. FUSE applies separate adaptive mixture modules to numerical and categorical features, allowing each feature to combine shared specialized subnetworks, while joint attention preserves information exchange across all columns. We also characterize the excess population risk from restricted conditioning contexts and bound the continuous Wasserstein generation error by endpoint-prediction risk. Comprehensive experiments on eight tabular datasets demonstrate that FUSE achieves strong and consistent performance across distributional fidelity and downstream utility metrics.
2608.07294.paper_summary_zh: 生成混合型表格數據需要共同建模多樣的特徵分佈及其複雜的跨列依賴關係。變分流匹配通過因子化分佈處理不同的端點，但將特徵特定的處理和跨列交互隱含在共享的骨幹中。我們引入了特徵級統一專門化與跨列交換（FUSE）以明確分離這些角色。FUSE對數值特徵和類別特徵應用獨立的自適應混合模塊，使每個特徵能夠結合共享的專門子網絡，同時聯合注意力保留所有列之間的信息交換。我們還描述了來自受限條件上下文的過剩人口風險，並通過端點預測風險界定連續的瓦瑟斯坦生成誤差。在八個表格數據集上的全面實驗表明，FUSE在分佈忠實性和下游效用指標上實現了強大而一致的性能。
